retrievalProfile.description: A 1960s-style collage featuring portrait cutouts with torn edges set against a dark vertical wood grain background with hand-drawn chalk-like typography.
triggerTerms: wood grain background with hand-painted text

recipe.visualDefinition: A multi-layered composition combining a dark, textured wood panel background with four vertical, irregularly torn paper strips containing individual portraits. The top section features expressive, textured hand-lettering and simple line-art doodles like hearts.
coreVisualRelationships: Vertical wood grain texture as the unifying foundation
Torn-edge paper strips creating a window effect for portraits
Hand-painted, high-contrast typography floating over the wood
Repetitive portrait framing across the horizontal axis
coreInvariants: Rough, deckled edges on the portrait inserts

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Four medium-close-up portraits arranged side-by-side in the lower two-thirds of the frame.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The large, textured title text in the upper third of the composition.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: From the large title at the top, down through the four portraits, ending at the tracklist at the bottom edge.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: The dark wood grain serves as the negative space, surrounding the torn paper inserts and text.

colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Low saturation with high value contrast between the dark wood and the bright paper inserts.
paletteRestrictions: Limit to earthy tones and pastels

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.baseSkeleton: Casual, slightly condensed sans-serif with irregular baselines
characterSpecificRedesigns: The letter 'Y' has a long, descending tail
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Pair expressive hand-lettering with a clean, small-scale sans-serif for metadata and tracklists.

candidateDirections.reason: Captures the textured, hand-painted look of the main title.
Approximate skeleton for the secondary metadata text.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a dark vertical wood grain background with four vertical torn-paper strips. Inside each strip, place a 1960s-style portrait of a woman with a beehive hairstyle, wearing a cream-colored jacket, against a light blue background.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add hand-painted, textured uppercase lettering in pink and yellow at the top. Add small white sans-serif text at the very bottom and top right corner.

verificationChecks: Is the wood grain texture clearly visible?
Do the portrait inserts have rough, torn paper edges?
Is the typography textured and hand-drawn in appearance?
Is the color palette warm and vintage-toned?

adjustableVariables: Subject matter within the torn paper
mustRedesign: Specific artist names and song titles
Exact facial features of the subjects
postGenerationChecks: Ensure the text looks painted on, not digitally overlaid
Verify the torn edges have a slight white paper-core reveal
Check that the wood grain is vertical and dark
Confirm the portraits have a soft, vintage film grain
recipe.reuseFormula: Dark vertical wood grain + [Number] torn paper portrait strips + hand-painted [Color] display text + vintage film grain overlay.
